metadata.method: Static source reads and saved JSON inspection; no runtime/model imports or execution. Artifact-only serialization. Model calls means experimental API/model invocations.
metadata.leakage_count_unit: Distinct data-boundary routes, not disjoint causal mechanisms or number of tasks. Primary type per route; current vs already-repaired legacy separated.
metadata.legacy_count_unit: 22 family/setting audit rows; overlapping families/settings, not task prevalence. Primary label counts; secondary leakage channels retained.

required_repairs.action: One Base/learner visible-context projection, with explicit privileged mode only

required_repairs.action: Whitelist scalar and bounded evidence supervision; remove expected actions/assertions and unrevealed simulator scripts from learner channels
required_checks: Semantic answer-leak checks, not ID regex alone; candidate-relative Level 2 maximum, fail closed.

required_repairs.action: Taint/provenance review for Diagnosis → compiler → proposal → Editor and prior Skills
required_checks: A valid E/P reference does not validate that a rule is inferable from permitted evidence; no safe-origin label from syntax alone.

required_repairs.action: Reclassify historical interpretation and re-audit CSG learnability under bounded feedback
required_checks: Preserve all scores; distinguish oracle-assisted input from causal proof; do not carry Phase12R STRONG claim across changed supervision ceiling.

required_repairs.action: Retain and extend metadata/holdout isolation checks
required_checks: No new reverse flow; hidden maps stay oracle-side; track outputs separately from inputs.

causal_limit: Confirmed access/transfer is not proof model relied on each source. No ablation or rerun performed.
